# Parts Trading Company

> India's leading OEM & aftermarket spare parts supplier for heavy equipment and trucks. Est. 1956, Mumbai. 53,000+ catalogued parts across Volvo, Scania, Komatsu, CAT, and Hitachi — plus OEM supply for 20+ additional brands. Same-day dispatch from Mumbai. Exports to Russia, UAE, Indonesia, South Africa, Australia, Nigeria, Kenya, and 50+ countries.
